messages:
noah-ae: attaching draft RFI response for Zenova. Open items: HSM/KMS wording, POC pricing example, dataset ingress controls, and the capability matrix. Quick scan?

anya-se: I'll take POC ops + runbook. Recommend 14-day sandbox with pre-signed S3 + temporary peering. Need input on teardown steps and cost.

jules-product: Ill own the capability matrix. Propose columns: baseline t/s, burst window, SLA, fallback model, cost note. Keep rows short.

neha-security: For ingress: pre-signed S3 + VPC peering OK. Require their sec contact to sign DAA. Retention default: delete-on-teardown, audit logs retained 90 days. KMS passthrough needs their KMS ARN for review.

ben-legal: I'll add KMS clause and a one-paragraph addendum about data handling. Note: reserved-capacity pilots change liability and payment milestones.

noah-ae: Zenova asked for a sample burst pricing for a 2-week POC: 1.5M tokens/day with 25% peak bursts. Any rough numbers?

anya-se: Back-of-napkin: prorated reserved ~$7k for two weeks on Dedicated; burst premium ~ $0.02/token during peak. I'll build a spreadsheet to refine.

jules-product: Matrix snippet pasted (two-line):
Hosted: baseline 400 t/s | burst 2m | SLA best-effort | fallback 7B quant | low cost
Dedicated: baseline 4k t/s | burst 10m | p99 SLA | fallback compatible family | reserved + burst
Private: infra-dependent | n/a | customer-managed | none | varies

neha-security: Phrase FedRAMP status as: "SOC2 Type II available; FedRAMP assessment planned for Private offering (timeline subject to vendor assessment)."

infra-bot: provision-sandbox: zenova-sbx created id sbx-7701; logs -> ops-logging.

noah-ae: Great. @jules-product and @anya-se update RFP packet with matrix, runbook, pricing table, SOW link and DAA; I'll send to Zenova EOD. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
